title: Green Tahini Sauce
description: Tahini blended with fresh herbs, garlic, lemon and green chile.

ingredients.item: fresh herbs: cilantro, parsley, mint, dill or basil

steps.do: Blend everything except the tahini until combined but still a little rough.
It will look far too thin. Add the tahini and blend until creamy and it thickens, leaving flecks of herb.
Taste and adjust salt, lemon and chile. Loosen with a little more water if you want a pourable sauce.

notes: Herbs: a mix of two or three is best (parsley, mint and cilantro is the author's favorite), but one works. Thin stems are fine.
Add 1 to 2 tsp za'atar if you like. Readers who like it sharper double the lemon; if the garlic is too strong for you, cut it back.
Oil-free: swap the olive oil for water and a little more tahini.
Keeps 5 days in a sealed jar in the fridge. Good with Sheet Pan Chicken Shawarma, falafel, Israeli Salad and mezze platters, or as a raw-vegetable dip.
nutrition: Per 2 tbsp: 95 cal · 1.9 g protein · 3.5 g carbs · 0.9 g fiber · 0.7 g sugar · 8.9 g fat · 1.3 g sat fat · 198.7 mg sodium
